httpProtocol.xmlOrdinalProtocol: 1-based member-node ordinal in the SHA-bound inspected HTTP XML, including the type as ordinal 1. This resolves an exact overload XML ID; names alone do not. Final package XML must be independently rebound, not treated as ordinal-stable after edits.
httpProtocol.perRowDimensions: Resolve accepted name/output from exact baseline; source row identifies eager guards and nullable optional mapper. No optional mapper is guarded. For nullable Result/Validation/UnitResult payload instantiations the mapper receives that nullable payload; Option Some is non-null by invariant. Sync HTTP default success is Ok(value), except UnitResult -> NoContent; supplied success mapper returning null throws InvalidOperationException. Selected problem mapper returning null or ProblemDetails without Status throws InvalidOperationException. Direct sync mapper exceptions propagate unchanged. Each async source row invokes its own async Core wrapper, whose natural await makes an input faulted OCE yield a canceled returned awaitable, unlike Result.TryAsync. Async Core awaits input exactly once, then invokes selected mapper once; unselected mappers are not invoked. Effect variants run immediately with context.RequestAborted after guards, not at IResult.ExecuteAsync. No independent ownership of cancellation is added to Task/ValueTask carrier mapping. These are source findings, not runtime receipts.
